minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to release $65,000 of Emerald Place bond and conditionally waived setbacks for Whitewoods building six.
minutes.summary: The board held an informational hearing on a 1259 Mass Ave site plan, continued to August 25. It then released part of the Emerald Place bond for paving Lakefront Road, and granted Whitewoods setback waivers contingent on town counsel. It approved minutes, heard committee reports, finalized charrette questions, picked training courses, and went into executive session.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at start; none.
A resident said the ownership of the Emerald Place roadway was never legally resolved; the town has maintained it since the 1800s and a title search was cloudy.

votes.motion: Continue the 1259 Mass Ave public hearing to August 25.
Release $65,000 of the Emerald Place bond as recommended by the DPW director.
Approve the Whitewoods building six waivers, contingent on legal counsel confirming the board's authority; amended to state the board believes it a minor change.
Support whatever decision conservation and open space make on the 145 Page Street right of first refusal.
Go into executive session on litigation strategy (O'Brien home v. Town), not to return to public session.

budget_items.what_was_said: Engineers' and DPW letters differed on how much of the bond to release; the developer asked for a partial release to pave Lakefront Road.
A per-unit payment goes back to a fund once building permits are issued for the fourth building.

decisions.decision: Applicant, engineers and department heads to hold a tech meeting before the August 25 continued hearing.
Emerald Place to return August 25; a pre-meeting with both engineers to be scheduled.
Chair will take the open space committee seat.
Joint economic development meeting to be scheduled for early September.
Training requests: master planning, planning with community support, site plan review.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to release part of the Emerald Place bond, as the DPW director recommended, so the developer can pave Lakefront Road; one member voted nay.
The board approved the Whitewoods building six setback waivers, contingent on legal counsel confirming its authority, with wording that it considers this a minor change.
The board voted to continue the 1259 Mass Ave public hearing to August 25, with a tech meeting of the applicant, engineers and department heads before it.
The board voted to support whatever decision conservation and open space makes on the 145 Page Street right of first refusal.
A resident said ownership of the Emerald Place roadway was never legally resolved and that a title search was cloudy.

why_it_matters: The Emerald Place bond is the town's security for finishing roads, and the engineers' and DPW letters differed on how much to release, so the size of the release affects what protection remains if work is left unfinished.

The Whitewoods waiver depends on a legal opinion that has not yet been given, and the unresolved roadway ownership question at Emerald Place could affect who is responsible for maintaining the road, a cost carried by the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: August 25: the continued 1259 Mass Ave hearing and the return of Emerald Place, with a pre-meeting of both engineers to be scheduled.
Town counsel's answer on the board's authority to grant the Whitewoods waivers, and a joint economic development meeting planned for early September.
